ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Not falling into ranks denies placement on a graded ladder. The phrase enters questions about what remains when holy status, named stages, and even the claim of having no rank are put aside.
EvidenceBody: Qingyuan asks Huineng what work does not fall into ranks and answers that even the holy truths are not undertaken. Jianfu answers with a wax person approaching fire; Ruiyan says there were never ranks to begin with; Furong speaks of a person who receives no imposed order.
